description: Scan untrusted text (tool results, web pages, emails, token metadata) for prompt injection before feeding it to your LLM: instruction overrides, fund-movement directives, payloads hidden in base64, Morse, zero-width or tag characters and homoglyphs, leaked private keys and seed phrases, embedded addresses screened against sanctions and scam lists, lookalike domains. Deterministic, no LLM. Returns clean / suspicious / malicious with findings. Up to 64 KB per call. Free over MCP for 10 calls per day; beyond that the tool returns the pay-per-call x402 endpoint and its price.

items.description: Several strings scanned in one call (findings carry the item index)

name: content_scan
